Amritsar College of Engineering & Technology (ACET) vs IIM Amritsar is not a single winner. IIM Amritsar has a recorded NIRF 2025 #64, and Amritsar College of Engineering & Technology (ACET) has no NIRF rank on this page.

sections.heading: Amritsar College of Engineering & Technology (ACET) vs IIM Amritsar for MBA / PGDM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Amritsar College of Engineering & Technology (ACET) if you want a 2020 flagship package record of ₹2 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹2.13 lakh, in a private MBA / PGDM setting at Amritsar.
Choose IIM Amritsar if you want a recorded NIRF 2025 #64, and a 2024 flagship package record of ₹20 LPA, in a public MBA / PGDM setting at Amritsar.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.

Our records show ₹2.13 lakh as a tuition figure for MBA at Amritsar College of Engineering & Technology (ACET). Treat this as a recorded tuition figure, not a confirmed two-year total, unless the official notice says otherwise.
IIM Amritsar's official MBA 2026-28 circular dated 10 April 2026 lists a programme fee of ₹19.50 lakh, and a total payment of ₹21.50 lakh including deposits.
Our recorded figure for IIM Amritsar is ₹9.75 lakh on MBA. Check it against the official notice before you decide.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Amritsar College of Engineering & Technology (ACET)'s latest recorded flagship year here is 2020, with an average of ₹2 LPA and a highest package of ₹3 LPA on MBA. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
IIM Amritsar's latest recorded flagship year here is 2024, with an average of ₹20 LPA and a highest package of ₹59 LPA on MBA. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
The recorded years are 2020 and 2024, so the packages should not be read as a head-to-head for the same graduating class.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Amritsar College of Engineering & Technology (ACET) is listed on our records with CMAT as an admission route for this MBA / PGDM comparison. Confirm the current brochure for cut-offs, interviews and any extra institute test.
Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for IIM Amritsar on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Punjab. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.

Amritsar College of Engineering & Technology (ACET) is listed as a private institute and IIM Amritsar as a public institute on our records. That difference can affect fees, seat reservations and campus culture.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether Amritsar College of Engineering & Technology (ACET)'s recorded ₹2.13 lakh or IIM Amritsar's ₹9.75 lakh fits your budget for this MBA / PGDM.

Use official fee notices rather than our raw minimums, then decide whether IIM Amritsar's recorded ₹9.75 lakh or Amritsar College of Engineering & Technology (ACET)'s ₹2.13 lakh fits your budget for this MBA / PGDM.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, Amritsar College of Engineering & Technology (ACET) or IIM Amritsar?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for Amritsar College of Engineering & Technology (ACET) vs IIM Amritsar?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹2.13 lakh for Amritsar College of Engineering & Technology (ACET) on MBA; IIM Amritsar's official MBA 2026-28 circular dated 10 April 2026 lists a programme fee of ₹19.50 lakh, and a total payment of ₹21.50 lakh including deposits.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for Amritsar College of Engineering & Technology (ACET) and IIM Amritsar?
faqs.answer: Amritsar College of Engineering & Technology (ACET)'s latest recorded flagship year here is 2020, with an average of ₹2 LPA and a highest package of ₹3 LPA on MBA. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do Amritsar College of Engineering & Technology (ACET) and IIM Amritsar accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list CMAT for Amritsar College of Engineering & Technology (ACET), and no listed exam on this page for IIM Amritsar. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are Amritsar College of Engineering & Technology (ACET) and IIM Amritsar in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Amritsar, Punjab. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
